Zara P.: Heads-up from the usability run: people are confused because the in-app "knowledge pane" label doesn't match the top nav. Nav says `Help`, the pane header says `Knowledge`, and inline CTAs use `View docs`.
Vincent H.: Agreed. We should pick one public-facing term. I like `Help` for nav (discoverability) and `Guides` for the pane content title.
Theo (design): Proposal: nav = `Help`, pane title = `Guides & examples`, breadcrumb shows `Guides > API reference`. Provides context without changing nav discoverability. I'll drop a quick mock.
Rina S.: Analytics note: we currently track help_click, knowledge_pane_open, and docs_link_click. If we rename we'll need an alias layer so historical dashboards don't break. I can own the mapping.
docs-bot: New doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/knowledge-pane-lexicon (created by @Theo (design)) :page_with_curl:
Zara P.: Accessibility nit: screen readers only read the pane as "Dialog". Toggle needs aria-expanded and a label. Suggested markup:
```
<button id="knowledge-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="knowledge-pane" aria-label="Open console guides">Help</button>
```
Vincent H.: Deep-linking inconsistency: links to anchors (e.g., docs.redwood.ai/#batching) open a new tab; users expect the pane to open and focus the section if it exists. Can we try pane.deepLink(anchor) first, and fall back to external?
Theo (design): UX detail: when deep-linking into the pane highlight the heading for ~2s and show a `Back to app` microcopy at the top. Keeps users oriented.
Rina S.: Implementation sketch: intercept clicks, if feature_flag knowledge_pane_enabled and contentExists(anchor) -> pane.open({anchor}) & emit event `knowledge_deeplink` with {anchor, mode: "pane"}; else open external and emit {anchor, mode: "external", fallback: "true"}. I'll add unit tests and an event migration shim.
Zara P.: Microcopy recommendation: global nav = `Help`, pane header = `Guides`, in-pane CTA = `Open in panel`, external CTA = `View full docs`. Short and consistent.
Vincent H.: Let's file a short RFC in #product-ship with owners: copy (Theo), analytics (Rina), frontend (Vincent). Timeline: feature-flag rollout, event aliasing, and accessibility audit.
Theo (design): I'll update Figma, add the highlight interaction and drop the accessibility checklist in the doc.
Rina S.: I'll draft the events mapping and shim.
Zara P.: Thanks team :thumbsup:
